algebra.expression: A = T[1.3deg,0.98] (N(Q_11^82) plus B_tangent(C_every3) plus R)
algebra.interpretation: Nested rectangles retain their original boundary language. Eleven-sided contours become normal vectors and one in three concentric circles becomes a tangent bundle, superimposing three incompatible descriptions of the same center.
algebra.order: Read operators right to left; tool flow arrays execute top to bottom. P changes paint, C changes shape, K maps colors, H creates concentric scale copies, N samples normal marks, B samples tangent or vertical marks, T is a small affine transform.
